title: Document Template Manager
notes: Added an owner and administrator Template Manager for invoices, FLHAs, pre trips, field tickets, incident reports, timesheets, work orders and custom documents.
Added Northborn-built starter templates with editable fields, required controls, reusable data bindings and live previews.
Added PDF template uploads with automatic fillable-field inspection and smart binding suggestions for common Northborn job, customer, fleet, safety and billing data.
Added template versions, active and archived states, document defaults, duplication and secure organization-scoped PDF storage support.
Added local preview storage so the Template Manager remains testable before the new database migration is enabled in a workspace.
